title: A clearer full-roster view
summary: The searchable roster has calmer controls, a visible result count and cards that adapt to phone and desktop widths.
changes: The full roster shows how many nights match the search and makes each night’s live plan easier to scan.
Search and staffing filters now use the shared light and dark controls, with clearer focus and touch targets.
The full-roster cards now use the correct responsive and dark-mode styles.
